verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.api.gusto.com. It uses OAuth2 connection with scoped, least-privilege data access and has documented setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini CLI. A separate Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server lets AI tools work with the Embedded Payroll API and its docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably beyond first-party docs and a docs-existence probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This is Gusto's official MCP server for connecting your own Gusto account.
Our MCP server provides an OAuth2 based connection process and allows you to select the categories of data to which your chosen LLM will have access.

The Embedded Dev Assistant Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI-powered code editors like Cursor and Windsurf, as well as general-purpose tools like Claude Desktop, to interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API and relevant documentation.
